_help: Level number on the start card. Edit, save, then press R in game to see it. Opacities and colours 0 to 1; startZoom 1 to 30; zoomSeconds 0 to 10; settledHeight 0.1 to 1.2 (share of screen height); fadeSeconds 0.05 to 5; fadeInSeconds 0 to 2; font: inter, montserrat, bebas or dmserif; easing: expo, quint, quart, cubic, sine or linear; edgeWidth 0.5 to 8 and innerShadeWidth 1 to 40 (pixels on a 1080 pixel tall screen). A missing or bad value uses the built-in default.
